checks.name: Period recovery
checks.detail: found the 3.66 ppt transit 1 more time in TESS (BTJD 3733.31; same depth and duration, above the 7.0σ false-alarm threshold); the dips don't fit one period without predicting a transit where TESS saw none: not one transiting body, or the repeats are something else; most probable P ≈ 611 d (68%: 290-1300 d), from the periods the data allow and the transit probability; a second transit fixes it: the next TESS sectors of the star, or ground photometry
checks.value: 16 sectors scanned (353 d): BTJD 3733.31, 5.03 ppt, SNR 17.4 · ZTF not used: the star (G 11.9) saturates it · ASAS-SN has no source at the star; ATLAS not used (needs an ATLAS_API_TOKEN) · 25% of 10.1-2000 d allowed by the TESS coverage
